stem.text: Haemoglobin can bind to carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide and oxygen.
Which statement about the binding sites of haemoglobin is correct?

A.text: Carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide bind to one site, oxygen binds to a different site.

B.text: Carbon dioxide and oxygen bind to one site, carbon monoxide binds to a different site.

C.text: Carbon monoxide and oxygen bind to one site, carbon dioxide binds to a different site.

D.text: Carbon monoxide, oxygen and carbon dioxide all bind to different sites.
